## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D1 (a, foundations). This is audit backlog UX-21 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: No screen changes. Every status chip, alert and banner in every role, through the library.
Findings and reviewers: F-20, F-19 · reviewers C-03, C-21. Part 1 of 3 of audit backlog UX-21 (part 2 builds Chip, Tag and Banner; part 3 replaces the local chips in features).
Rationale: Tokens style the chrome and 103 raw hex colours style the meaning. Dark and high-contrast themes cannot be built on literals, web and native can drift, and a palette fix means editing look tables by hand.
Proposed UX behaviour: Add a tone layer to the tokens: danger, warning, success, info, brand, ai and neutral, each with a foreground, background and border value taken from the colours used today. Repoint the look tables in packages/ui/src/primitives.tsx to the tones, with no visual change. The contrast test in packages/ui reads the tone tokens, so a tone that fails 4.5:1 for text or 3:1 for a border fails the build. The names match the Tone type already used in packages/ui-native. Delete the dead dark: variants in tabs.tsx and switch.tsx. The raw-hex count in the ratchet for packages/ui falls to zero and its lint rule turns to error.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/08-design-system-blueprint.md section 6 (tone table and rules).
Components and tokens affected: tokens.json (tone layer), styles.css, primitives.tsx, primitives.test.tsx (contrast), tabs.tsx and switch.tsx (dead classes).
Front end and back end split: Front end only.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the type and spacing token ticket (same two files; that one merges first). The clinical components of wave D1b rebase on this.
Clinical sign-off: Review only: the looks must be unchanged. The allergy look itself is decided in part 2 (question 4 of the validation plan).
Effort and regression risk: M · Low, if the comparison is exact. Any difference is a mapping error.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) A new allergy presentation (part 2, needs clinical sign-off). (2) Dark and high-contrast themes (MDV-P5-023, which must not start before this ticket). (3) Any change to the palette.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the tokens, when the tone layer is read, then danger, warning, success, info, brand, ai and neutral each have a text, background and border value and a written meaning
- [ ] **AC2.** Given packages/ui/src, when it is searched for hex colours in class names or style objects, then there is none, the ratchet count is zero and the lint rule is an error
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the /__ui gallery, when every status primitive is captured before and after in English and Arabic, then no pixel differs
- [ ] **AC4.** Given the contrast test, when a tone's text colour is changed to one that gives less than 4.5:1, then the test fails
- [ ] **AC5.** Given every primitive that uses a tone, when it renders, then it carries a text label, and an icon where one existed before
- [ ] **AC6.** Given packages/ui and packages/ui-native, when the tone names are compared, then they are the same seven

## Test notes

- Vitest: contrast test repointed; mutation shown in the pull request (one failing colour).
- Playwright: gallery capture comparison, axe clean in en and ar.
